summary: Adds a benchmark script under scripts/ that builds a ~40MB db and times db.all() and a search, to show where JSONStorage read time goes. Only an initial code investigation has happened so far.
narrative: The owner suspected JSONStorage re-parses the whole file on every query and asked for measured numbers rather than a guess. Memory shows one observation: an initial read of tinydb/storages.py found that JSONStorage re-reads and fully parses the db file on each table read path. That matches the owner's hypothesis, but no benchmark script, timings or write-up have been recorded yet. The request is at the exploration stage.
